# BrandBase - AI Context

BrandBase builds custom operational business management systems ("Bases"), conversion-first websites, and full-service brand management engines for growing businesses and category leaders.

## Core Documentation & Services

### Growth Solutions
- [Brand Management](https://brandbase.in/growth-solutions/brand-management): full-service brand stewardship, visual identity kits in Figma, high-retention video production (Reels / Shorts), narrative copywriting, in-app SEO, native publishing, and community care.
- [Premium Static Websites](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/premium-static-websites): high-performance static websites built for sub-second loading and clean conversions.
- [Custom Web Design](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/custom-web-design): bespoke enterprise React and Next.js digital flagships for scaling businesses.
- [eCommerce Development](https://brandbase.in/website-solutions/ecommerce-development): conversion-first storefronts on Shopify and custom headless stacks.

### Management Solutions
- [Clinic Management System](https://brandbase.in/management-solutions/health): patient record histories, dynamic intake forms, live queue status boards, WhatsApp recalls, and billing.
- [Coaching Management System](https://brandbase.in/management-solutions/education): student batch schedules, attendance registers, video course hosting, and fee reminders.
- [Restaurant Management System](https://brandbase.in/management-solutions/food-hospitality): live order screens, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), table reservations, and QR menu sync.

## Resources
- [Our Work](https://brandbase.in/our-work): live portfolio and client outcomes across healthcare, hospitality, education, and retail.
